rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for movement or sound that has a discernible rhythm.

example.english: They dance in a rhythmic way.
example.traditional: 佢哋跳舞跳得好有節奏。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 tiu3 mou5 tiu3 dak1 hou2 jau5 zit3 zau3

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on regular repetition or patterned motion rather than musical rhythm.

example.english: The waves hit the shore in a rhythmic pattern.
example.traditional: 海浪一下一下咁有規律噉拍打住岸邊。
example.jyutping: hoi2 long6 jat1 haa5 jat1 haa5 gam2 jau5 kwai1 leot6 gam2 paak3 daa2 zyu6 ngon6 bin1

rows.jyutping: tung4 zit3 zau3 jau5 gwaan1 ge3
rows.note: Use this before a noun when the meaning is specifically “related to rhythm.”

example.english: I signed up for a rhythmic dance class.
example.traditional: 我報咗個同節奏有關嘅舞蹈班。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou3 zo2 go3 tung4 zit3 zau3 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 mou5 dou6 baan1
